body.x: Kyung Dong Navien(www.kdnavien.co.kr) will be introducing its high-efficiency boilers at Korea Energy Show 2016, which will run Nov. 8-11 at KINTEX.

This boiler can also produce electricity as it provides heat. It is designed to be eco-friendly with smartphone control system for remote controlling of the boiler. The performance has improved greatly, saving more energy than night-time boilers by 60%.
Kyung Dong Navien is the first company in Asia to develop the condensing boiler, with number one export market share for 24 years.

Hosted by MOTIE and organized by Korea Energy Agency, Korea Energy Show 2016 is a comprehensive trade show covering new energy business, new and renewable energy, high-efficiency energy, energy environment, and energy policy technology. It was prepared to provide marketing support to the energy companies to contribute to the development and stimulation of the energy industry of Korea.
